563794.Description:
[Vortex] (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. Then, unsuspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon unsuspend, for the turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon and gets +3000 DP.
[Rule] Trait: Has [Bird Dragon] Type.

565050.Description: [Fortitude] (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)

565051.Description: [When Attacking] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

565052.Description: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Bird]/[Avian] in one of its traits and 1 card with the [Vortex Warriors]/[LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

565053.Description: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon is suspended by an effect, 1 of your Digimon with [Bird] in one of its traits or with the [Vortex Warriors] trait gets +3000 DP until then end of your opponent's turn.
565053.Inherited Effect: [Piercing] (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)

[On Play] [On Deletion] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

565056.Description:
[Security] You may play 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait and a play cost of 4 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
[Vortex] (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)

[On Deletion] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Avian]/[Bird]/[Vegetation]/[Plant] in one of its traits and 3000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[Rule] Trait: Has the [Vegetation] type.

565058.Description: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspends your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Bird]/[Avian] in one of its traits with 3000 DP or less below from your hand without paying the cost.
565058.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
